get.summary: Read original service counter confirmation and placement state
get.description: Current merchant scope and CHECKOUT_PREPARE + ORDER_VIEW are required. Business payload is CheckoutService.CounterState; the outer envelope follows the host API convention. Only an unaccepted expired quote may transition to REQUOTE_REQUIRED under its original lock; accepted or unknown placement is preserved.

200.description: Business payload: nullable confirmation (ManualServiceAdmissionPort.CounterConfirmation), result (CheckoutPort.CheckoutResult), canAccept (boolean). canAccept requires the original actor/realm/kind/account and QUOTED without confirmation; it does not replace write permissions.
